field_under_test.frame_layout: BE u16 tag | BE u16 frame_len | BE u16 body_len | u8 type | u8 opcode_or_status | payload

layout_validation.rule: frame_len equals the complete USB bulk payload length and body_len equals frame_len - 4

out_type_by_tag.notable_equality: For each tag, the type-0x01 EP01 OUT count exactly equals the EP81 IN count: tag 0 has 2601 and tag 1 has 833.

type_0x00_detail.response_semantics: candidate response-less/one-way form; no claim beyond this capture

ordered_response_evidence.method: Remove the 290 type-0x00 OUT frames, then compare the tag sequence of the remaining 3434 OUT frames with the tag sequence of all 3434 IN frames in capture order.
ordered_response_evidence.interpretation: The IN frame mirrors the corresponding FIFO-ordered type-0x01 OUT tag. The 47 apparent adjacent tag mismatches occur when two requests are outstanding, so immediate adjacency is not a safe pairing rule.

correlation: 0x09 occurs with both tags (1028 tag 0x0000, 127 tag 0x0001), so tag is not merely an opcode-family bit.

temporal_shape.interpretation: Tag 0x0000 dominates long baseline runs, while tag 0x0001 is concentrated in shorter, faster bursts. Both values repeat and are not unique per transaction.

hypothesis.primary: The first u16 is a two-valued logical message-class or channel selector that is copied from a response-bearing EP01 request into its FIFO-corresponding EP81 response.
hypothesis.tag_0x0000_role: Baseline/control-polling-oriented class in this session; it carries all observed type-0x00 candidate one-way traffic and the long 0x01/0x09 runs.
hypothesis.tag_0x0001_role: Burst-oriented class in this session; it is strongly associated with the 0x08 and 0x0a families and exclusively carries the observed 0x0b-0x11 subset listed above.
hypothesis.why_not_transaction_id: Only two values occur, identical values repeat for runs as long as 771 requests, and the field correlates strongly with opcode and burst class. It can assist response association but is not a unique transaction identifier.
hypothesis.why_not_response_flag: Both values occur in OUT and IN. The separate type byte, not the tag alone, cleanly accounts for the 290 OUT frames without an IN counterpart.
hypothesis.semantic_limit: The capture proves framing, counts, ordering, and correlation. It does not distinguish among channel ID, subsystem selector, command namespace, priority class, or another vendor-defined role.

key_conclusion: 0x0000 and 0x0001 are best treated as echoed logical class/channel tags, not lengths or unique transaction numbers: every type-0x01 OUT tag is mirrored in FIFO order by an IN tag (3434/3434), while tag 0x0000 marks long baseline/one-way activity and tag 0x0001 marks shorter command bursts.
boundary: Single observational session with no controlled stimulus, host call trace, or device firmware symbol map. Opcode and tag names are intentionally not promoted to vendor semantics.
